changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExternalMeasureResult') BEGIN CREATE TABLE metrics.ExternalMeasureResult ( Id bigint identity not null, AssetUid uniqueidentifier not null, AssetVersionUid uniqueidentifier not null, EffectiveDate date, [Value] bit not null, CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricExternalMeasureResult] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( Id ASC ) ) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: if not exists (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[metrics].[ExternalMeasureResult]') AND name = N'IX_metrics_ScoreItem_AssetVersionUid') begin CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MetricExternalMeasureResult_AssetUid] ON [metrics].[ExternalMeasureResult] ( [AssetUid] ASC ) end
